commentSubject: I've gotten a lot of questions about the game mechanics so I'll try to explain a bit better! During the entire game you are in your office; you never leave. You have a meter that shows you how much energy you are currently consuming. Having the security doors closed in your office or using the hallways lights consume extra energy. Looking at your monitors also uses extra power, so it's best to check them quickly. If your power runs out before the night is over, your doors can't be closed and your lights go off, putting you at the mercy of the animatrons. You want to check your cameras often to see if you can safely leave the doors open for a while longer (to save energy). If you can't locate one of the animatrons on the cameras then it's a good idea to turn on the hall light briefly to make sure it's not right outside your door. If it is, then you can close the security doors and leave them shut until the animatron leaves. The goal of each night is to make it to 6 am without letting one of them get inside! There are four animatrons that can get you (although only three appear here in the screenshots). The chicken, ''Chica'', tries to get in from the right door. The rabbit, ''Bonnie'', approaches from the left. Freddy Fazbear himself only attacks if you run out of power before the night is over. The fourth robot is behind the curtain of Pirate Cove and remains hidden most of the time. He becomes more active when the player doesn't check the cameras often, eventually causing him to run down the hall in a frenzy and into your office! When you survive five nights, you get your paycheck and have beaten the game. ;)
